_comment: THE SOUND MAP (yours to edit!). Each entry: a game-moment id → the file that plays there. One sound means ONE thing (the designer's rule, 2026-08-25): the store bell is only the merchant, the level-up ding is only 'enough XP earned'. Spells play by ELEMENT CLASS: spells.json fx.sound picks spell_fire / spell_frost / spell_lightning / spell_light / spell_arcane; heals and buffs use spell_heal / spell_buff automatically. To change a sound: drop the file in assets/sfx/ and point the id at it. To SILENCE a moment: delete its line — a missing id plays NOTHING, never a wrong sound. MOMENT IDS THE ENGINE ALREADY CALLS but that are DELIBERATELY SILENT (designer's call 2026-08-26 — add a line here if you ever change your mind): battle_victory, battle_start; gear_equip is now just the fallback for gear that fits no equip_* category. level_drain is mapped but the game has no level-drain mechanic yet. 2026-08-26: sounds now come from the New-Spell-Sounds pack AND the BIF archives (extracted/SFXSOUND) — audition at http://localhost:8137/soundboard.html and /biffboard.html — the old mp3s are still in assets/sfx/ if you want any back. FUTURE-USE SHELF (designer's notes 2026-08-26): sff_combansh = banshee howl, sff_comweird = genie/efreeti laugh, sff_expgdisp = mysterious/vanishing; the vs_chant_* casting voices are RESERVED for level-5 spells (unbuilt). New spell elements sonic/cloud/web are valid fx.sound values in spells.json, mapped below and waiting for spells to use them.
